sonnet.problem: This story card tells the people's 'Amen' after every curse, and the twelve-curse count, for verses 15-26. That is before the cards for verses 16-25 have come up, so the card jumps ahead of the passage. The next choice card then goes back to verse 16.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.

sonnet.problem: The question says 'the Levites go to the edge of a neighbor's land'. The text has the Levites proclaiming the curses, and never says they go anywhere. This adds a setting.
sonnet.rule: No added settings. No setting the text doesn't give.

sonnet.problem: The true/false question asks about the act of violence itself, a man who strikes down his neighbor in secret, instead of the choices or results around it.
sonnet.rule: Choice cards ask about the choices and results around them, never the act itself.
